title.suggested: Denver Ed Smith comes to St. Louis for Tom Allen's backing

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that "Denver Ed" Smith and his brother Paddy had come to St. Louis and were staying with Tom Allen, who would back Smith if he could get a match with a prominent pugilist.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Sunday Morning, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, June 13, 1897.

facts.fact: Heavyweight "Denver Ed" Smith and his brother Paddy came to St. Louis and stayed at Tom Allen's place
Allen offered to back "Denver Ed" Smith if he could get a match with a prominent pugilist, in which case Smith would train in St. Louis

notes: The subhead 'Here to Get Tom Allen's Money Back of Him' means Allen's financial backing, not a debt. This item says Denver Ed arrived 'last night' (June 12), but article 175 says he arrived at 3 a.m. Monday (June 14); dates left at month level. Current summary's McCoole/Mace mention is not in the article.
